Kit summary

Shadowless SlashBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 450% ATK [Poison] DMG to a single enemy, and steals 20% Effect Hit from them for 2 turns.
Nine Luminaries of the Moon Lv.1Serpent Cross Slash additionally reduces the target's Turn Meter by 50%. After casting Serpent Cross Slash, additionally casts Shadowless Slash on the target once.
Serpent Cross SlashActiveExclusive Lv.1
Attacks a single enemy, removing all buffs from the target and dealing 2 stages of 500% ATK [Poison] DMG each to them, with a 50% chance to steal 20% Mastery from the target for 2 turns.
Nine Luminaries of the Moon Lv.1Serpent Cross Slash additionally reduces the target's Turn Meter by 50%. After casting Serpent Cross Slash, additionally casts Shadowless Slash on the target once.
Channeling · MyojinPassiveExclusive Lv.3
When an ally steals an attribute from an enemy, Chiyo gains 1 layer of [Serpent Spirit] (increases ATK by 3% and [Poison] DMG by 3%). If the stolen attribute is Effect Hit, gains 1 extra layer of [Serpent Spirit]. When [Serpent Spirit] reaches 10 layers, immediately casts Ninpo · Venom Curse once and consumes all [Serpent Spirit].
Nine Luminaries of the Moon Lv.3When allies (excluding Chiyo) deal [Poison] DMG, Chiyo gains 1 additional layer of [Serpent Spirit] (this effect can trigger up to 5 times before Chiyo acts). When Chiyo has 5 or more layers of [Serpent Spirit], she becomes immune to control effects and increases her Speed by 50%. Each time [Serpent Spirit] is consumed, inflicts [Corrupted Body] on all enemies. [Corrupted Body]: reduces Mastery and Crit DMG by 50%, and then records DMG taken. Afterward, deals DMG equal to 80% of the recorded value after 2 turns and removes this effect.
Ninpo · Venom CurseActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants [ATK Up II] to all allies for 2 turns, with a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Hex] on all enemies for 2 turns. [Hex]: Each layer reduces Mastery RES by 20% and increases [Poison] DMG taken by 20%, up to 2 layers. Afterward, attacks all enemies, dealing 200% ATK DMG and [Poison] DMG equal to 80% ATK * layers of [Serpent Spirit].
Nine Luminaries of the Moon Lv.2When casting Ninpo · Venom Curse, removes 1 debuff from all allies and inflicts [Feebleness II] and [Paralyze II] on the targets for 2 turns. When consuming [Serpent Spirit] to cast Ninpo · Venom Curse, removes all removable [Shields] from enemies. If an enemy has an unremovable [Shield], increases DMG dealt by 200%. If 3 or more enemies have the [HP Deduction] tag, additionally increases DMG dealt by 200%.
Source: game files.

Traveler’s Diary
The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.

At max level
Uplifting Drums
Uplifting Drums
Main statEffect Hit

Increases all allies' ATK by 7% when a battle starts.

If an ally is inflicted with Block Removal, the ally will gain 1 layer of Energizing Notes at the end of the following 3 turns, up to 1 layer can be gained at the end of each turn. Each layer of Energizing Notes increases ATK by 1.4%, up to 40 layers. This effect will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.

Additionally, when an ally is inflicted with Block Removal in their first 3 turns each wave, there is a 100% chance to gain 1 extra layer. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.

If the same Echo is equipped by multiple allies at the same time in a battle, only one of them will take effect.

Moongazing Phantom
Moongazing Phantom
Main statATK Rate

Increases the owner's Poison DMG dealt by 21%.

If the owner is from Sword Harbor Guards:

1. When dealing Poison DMG, increases the target's DoT taken by 30%, up to 5 layers, lasting for 2 turns.
